prevention.title: Prevention
prevention.description: Pre-event or in-event risk prevention mechanisms, such as blocking, interception, and restriction measures.

perception.title: Perception
perception.description: Pre-event or in-event risk perception mechanisms, such as monitoring, alerting, and early warning measures.

detection.title: Detection
detection.description: In-event risk detection mechanisms, such as identification, verification, and recognition measures.

disposition.title: Disposition
disposition.description: In-event or post-event risk disposition mechanisms, such as handling, response, and remediation measures.
